title: Invalid page language
user_impact: Screen readers choose a wrong or the default pronunciation.
technical_impact: Invalid value in the html element's lang attribute.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.1.1 Language of Page; ACT bf051a (HTML page lang attribute has valid language tag); BCP 47 (RFC 5646) §2.1
applicability: The root html element of the top-level document when its lang attribute has a non-empty value.
expectation:
Fails when the primary language subtag of the root's lang value is not a valid
BCP 47 language subtag: "english" (not a registered subtag), "en_US" (the
underscore is no subtag separator, so the whole value is the primary subtag).
Region and script subtags ("en-GB", "de-AT") are valid. An absent or empty lang
is not applicable here (ACT bf051a applies to non-empty values only); that case
is document/lang-missing. One finding at the html element.

failing.html:
Page with an invalid lang attribute

The html lang attribute above ("english") is not a 2-3 letter BCP 47 subtag.
